sender: Shibuya City Office, Tax Division (渋谷区 区民部 税務課)
summary: This is your resident tax bill for fiscal year 2026 (Shibuya ward tax and Tokyo metropolitan tax). The total is 98,400 yen, paid in 4 instalments or all at once by June 30, 2026.

actions.title: Pay the 1st instalment of resident tax
how: Pay with the enclosed payment slip at a bank, post office bank (Japan Post Bank), convenience store, or the Shibuya City Office tax counter
Or pay with a smartphone payment app by scanning the slip's barcode, or online at the eLTAX payment site

actions.title: Pay the 2nd instalment of resident tax
how: Pay with the enclosed payment slip at a bank, post office bank (Japan Post Bank), convenience store, or the Shibuya City Office tax counter

actions.title: Pay the 3rd instalment of resident tax
how: Pay with the enclosed payment slip at a bank, post office bank (Japan Post Bank), convenience store, or the Shibuya City Office tax counter

how: Pay with the enclosed payment slip at a bank, post office bank (Japan Post Bank), convenience store, or the Shibuya City Office tax counter

consequences.text: If you do not pay by the deadline, you will receive a reminder letter (督促状) and late fees (延滞金) may be charged for each day after the deadline.

source.text: 納期限までに納付がない場合は、督促状を送付します。

glossary.reading: とくべつくみんぜい・とみんぜい
glossary.meaning: resident tax paid to your Tokyo ward and to Tokyo
you pay the tax yourself (not deducted from salary)
